description:
NOT a v1 goal — activated when the French market is prioritized. The ADR-003 audit trail is designed so this epic is purely additive: period closures (Z/daily/monthly/fiscal-year), fiscal archives, audit export in an auditor-consumable format, across all cash paths (web, POS, cashless). First task when picked up: verify the inferred ISCA reading (inalterability, security, conservation, archiving — art. 286-I-3° bis CGI / NF525 referential) against the referential's actual text.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Closures compute and seal period totals; sealed periods are provably inalterable
- Fiscal archive export in an auditor-consumable format
- Profile lands with zero schema/flow changes to the ADR-003 journal — this validates the ADR's core claim
- Requirements traceable to the NF525 referential text; gaps explicitly listed

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map) · docs/adr/ADR-003-append-only-audit-trail.md

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.

Scope amended pre-Gate-1 (owner directive 2026-07-12): NF525 is NOT an immediate goal — it becomes a later-phase French-market profile. The underlying requirement is generalized: traceability is a must, with the same audit-trail thinking for money AND tickets (ADR-003 reworked accordingly).
